tryThis: Replace `<< "\n"` on the last line by `.operator<<( "\n" )`: it prints an **address**. The *member* `operator<<` has no `const char*` overload, so the string converts to `const void*`. The free `operator<<(ostream&, const char*)` is the one that prints text.
